posts.author: rodya
posts.body: Hello, I want to design my own characters using RPG Maker MV. Can you recommend any applications or methods for this? (My priority is free applications.)

posts.author: SGHarlekin
posts.body:
What does this mean? Design your own characters using rpg maker mv? That implies you want to design them with rpg maker, which you can via the included generator.
If you want to use 3rd party software, that's not "using rpg maker mv" to design the characters, is it?
If you mean you want to design spritesheets that have rpg maker format, you should probably say that.
There's Schlangan's extended generator, which gives you more option s than the included one, but otherwise I'm not aware of any 3rd party software that does sprietesheets specifically for rpg maker.
